'''Zhir Tolavor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tolavor was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], but left to become a trader. After traveling to several planets, Tolavar decided to settle on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] with his lifemate and they raised a family there. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Tolavar traveled to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to finalize a business deal about some rare [[Wine/Legends|wine]] and while he was there, Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], killing his family.<ref name="COL" />

Tolovor vowed to do all he could to fight the Empire and sold everything he had. He then purchased some weapons and joined the Rebel Alliance, where he volunteered for dangerous missions. He joined the crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]'' and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], traveled aboard the ship to [[Dalicron-4]], where he and the rest of the crew rescued the child [[Caeleb]].<ref name="COL" />

Four months later, Caeleb was kidnapped by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] and the crew of the ''Katarn'' were again tasked with rescuing the boy. They tracked Rystra to the planet [[Pamorjal]], but after the ''Katarn'' was destroyed by the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], they began to fly the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'' instead. They attacked Rystra in the [[Cavern of Light]] on a remoted world and rescued Caeleb.<ref name="soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref>

The Alliance reformed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and Tolovar continued to serve it in it's new incarnation. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], he and the rest of the crew of the ''Dancer'' flew to the [[Temple of Pain]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], where they confronted Rystra and his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Valik Kodank]].<ref name="LOD" />
